# WP1-b: Sherlock benign envelope from train data

Load bounds = min and max of P / nominal over all train records, widened by 0.01. Controllable elements get their physical range: sgen P in [0, 1] of rated, storage P in [-1, 1] of nominal (operators change setpoints; test contains benign setpoint changes not seen in train). Load Q fixed at nominal (constant in the recording). Taps: positions seen in train. Topologies: connected with at most one closed loop, up to two lines out (Sherlock runs meshed after maintenance). Saved to `rules/sherlock_envelope.json`.
